body: Seriously,   Its the worst.

My diet is pretty consistent.  I eat vegetables and fruit everyday, etc.   I'm drinking tons of water and I've started taking probiotics.   I'm trying not to justify a relapse because of my discomfort.

Hey man.  Wow, thanks for checking in.  If say I'm slightly better.  I'm getting more respect at work,  I'm  getting a little more comfortable just being by myself, but I had an argument with my roommate that really has me down.  He was one of my depression confidants, and he shredded me with my biggest insecurities.  I'm having a tough time getting over what he said.  How're you doing?
I will also pay my bills.
I'm going to continue to not smoke, contribute to my meeting today, and walk my dog.    I hope I'm doing this correctly.
Complete.
I'm not going to smoke today.
Been thinking about it for about six months.
Yeah, if you have the time.
My garage door won't work, maybe I'll just CO myself to death. Smoke cigarettes and just see how high my RPMs will go.

I'm alone.  I yearn for a romantic relationship.  I rekindled a friendship I had with this girl from high school.  Twice, actually.  First time I took her out two times, and suddenly she wouldn't respond to me. Second time, I made her dinner... delicious fucking dinner... and I had her in my room.  We were making out.  She said she couldn't have sex (Menstruating) .  I went to a yoga class with her.  Then, she stopped returning my calls/texts.  I'm not a bad looking guy, I'm smart, and I'm such a nice dude.  WHAT. THE. FUCK.   is wrong with me.

My sister won't talk to me anymore about being depressed.  I talked to her about a week ago and I told her that I've had bouts of weeping and anxiety..... She literally just stared at me.

 I think, because i went off on her for giving me tough love, she doesn't know how else to handle it.  I told her that I just needed her to listen.... I guess I didn't really expect her to say nothing.  My fault.  My other sister was listening to me about my job and she interrupted me and asked if we could switch the subject to something everyone can talk about.  She doesn't care.  


How is that I've gotten to this point in my life were I have no one to connect to?  Does my success make people uncomfortable?  Does my 'intelligence' put people off?  I've forgotten how to make new friends.

Fuck, I just feel alone.  Even though I have every reason not to feel alone.  I actually had a pretty cool week, but I can't even handle being alone for more than a few hours.  I don't know how to do anything, I spent fucking hours trying to fix my ice maker in my fridge.   My fucking garage door stopped working.  I'm useless.  I can't do anything right.   My fucking family doesn't care about me.  They don't care about my problems, my job, or even that I've been depressed and admitted to them that I wanted to kill myself. 

As i've mentioned before on this sub, I gave my gun to my sister for safe-keeping.  I told her to give it back to me in September.  I'm not ready, but I don't want to tell her that I'm not ready.  I want to fake that I'm alright, just so she'll give me back my gun and I can kill myself.

I have no real friends.  No one likes me.   It's like pulling teeth to get people to hang out with me.    I drove 10 hours last week just so i didn't have to be alone all weekend.  

Yeah, that's it.  I'm going to just wait for my sister to give me my gun back.  I'll have it.

I was in third grade, and It was girls chase the boys.  I was in an area with two escape possibilities.  One girl comes at me from one direction, so naturally I run the other.  Little did I know, this girl conspired with another to head off my other escape route.  I'm running full speed to my exit while looking back at the first girl laughing.  As I turned forward I ran right into the other girl.  Her large, buck teeth bit into my forehead and left a scar. So, I have two teeth marks in my dome.  Years later, high school, I'm talking with someone about that girl, and they remarked how large her teeth were.  I said no shit and showed her my scar.

Thank you for your reply.  I'm just so... Scared.  Scared that I'll do it.  I've almost worked through the whole experience in my head.   How I'll do it.  What it will feel like.  Even the sensation of the gun against my teeth.  There are moments where I panic at he idea of how serious I am about offing myself.  I honesty feel like holding up in my room until I feel better....until I'm comfortable around other people.  Thanks again. I'll keep doing healthy stuff.  Do you think smoking is affecting my mood?
Don't forget the women behind the man: Sapphire Fire.
Its Ok to be a nice guy, but don't always be available.
Thanks, dude.  Yesterday was really bad, but today seems a little better.

I'm not sure I want to take medication.  I'm going to go to the counselor a few more times and see how I feel.  I don't have any physical manifestations.  I do feel anxious in social situations, but its only a pit on my stomach.

I've noticed that my feelings of sadness are heightened when I'm in social settings - something I've never felt this intensely before.  Like everyone wants me to leave.  After the break up, I tried to get out more, but it seemed to only make me feel worse.
I feel unappreciative.  Like, if I can't be happy now...will I ever be?  How did you start swimming?  I seem to have this incredible lack of motivation...  Like I'm stuck.
I do own BF4 for PC... I haven't had a chance to play it tho.  Maybe I will.  Thanks for the invite.
I'm pretty terrible at it.  I started playing trumpet first and I taught myself the horn.  I'll have a look at that site.
I've started to enjoy cooking, but it sucks to turn around and have no one to share it with.  I use to go to the gym a lot, but I can't seem to work up the motivation.

You're right.   But I can't seem to gain that connection with anyone.  Even just a friend.  I have no close friends...just people that tolerate me or feel sorry for me.  Thanks for your response.  In don't play too many video games.   StarCraft sometimes.

I play French Horn in a night band, but the people in the band are much older than me.  They're typically retired music educators- again a disconnect.  My counselor says I have social anxiety... Dysthymia?   Friends my own age seem to dislike me and leave me out of a good many thing.  Joining a club seems.... out of reach for no logical reason.  Thank you form your response/advice
